id: title:Gilbert09:recognize a bare http 400 as a non clickhouse response

review.posthog_relevance: Adds diagnostic clarity for ClickHouse warehouse ingestion errors by distinguishing proxy/WAF rejections from genuine query failures.
review.reason: The supplied hunk P1.F2.H2 adds a comment and an entry to an error translation dictionary. This improves the diagnostic quality of error messages when ClickHouse ingestion fails, helping users distinguish between transient proxy rejections and actual query errors. No executable implementation changes are supplied, only comments and test assertions, which supports a score of 1.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of diagnostic improvements, but the lack of executable implementation changes and the absence of test execution results or actual error behavior demonstration in the supplied hunks limits confidence. The benefit is inferred from the comment and dictionary entry rather than demonstrated runtime behavior.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are comments and test assertions; no executable implementation changes are supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment explaining that bare HTTP 400 responses without X-ClickHouse-Exception-Code header indicate a proxy/WAF rejection rather than a ClickHouse query error, and adds a corresponding entry to the error translation dictionary.

observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion error handling and user-facing diagnostics; distinguishes transient proxy rejections from genuine ClickHouse query failures.
